ns2:course.label: Criminal Proc: Adjudication
ns2:course.description: (LAW 317) Problems in the administration of criminal justice, with emphasis upon the commencement of formal proceedings (bail, decision to prosecute, grand jury, preliminary hearing, location of prosecution, scope of prosecution, speedy trial); the adversary system (pleas, discovery, jury trials, prejudicial publicity, ethical problems, double jeopardy); and post-conviction review (post-trial motions, appeals, habeas corpus, related post-conviction remedies). 3 professional hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: LAW 604 and LAW 605.
